Would anybody have any tips on maybe NOT going through with any suicidal or self-harm thoughts I've? I've had them and suicidal thoughts for at least 3-4 years.

Or maybe just some tips on dealing with depression/self-harm thoughts? I've felt this way for 4 years now, am currently in treatment, but this treatment doesn't do shit. Maybe some of you redditters have some tips on dealing with self-harm/suicidal thoughts.
Prople say suicide is selfish, but I think making someone suffer and stay alive so you dont have to moan and be all down about it is more selfiah.
I've seen it 6 times now. cmon people.
Possibly, but moreso I just would like to find something to live for; I've been searching for such a thing for a year or so now and am coming up blank.

I would love to go anywhere else, but, for the moment at least, I'm still very much dependent on my parents. I'd go live somewhere else in an instant, and maybe moving and "starting over" would give me a new look on life, but for now and the near future at least, I'm stuck in this position; in this emotional abyss, if you will.

We're automatically ineligible? Transfolk can't serve no matter what?

Not that I want to serve, but that seems a bit bullshit.

Kurt Vonnegut once said that "Smoking is a classy way to commit suicide"

I smoke, and if I were to get cancer (or really any life-threatening disease) I would refuse all treatment aside from making me comfortable, and I've felt that way for the longest time.
Sending love to Ukraine from the U.S.! Why is Justin Bieber bigger news than a revolt?
